Trader consensus, with 38°C or higher leading at 41% ahead of 35-37°C outcomes at 35.5% each, reflects skepticism from early May's heatwave—where heat indices exceeded 40°C despite mid-30s air temperatures—and historical urban heat island effects amplifying peaks. Differentiating factors include afternoon cloud development versus prolonged subsidence, with model spreads on sea breeze strength; watch PAGASA's daily updates for refined guidance ahead of resolution.
